blocking_reasons.entry-6421: The read White House fact sheet concerns a new federal-employee category and accountability policy; it does not establish a centralized list compiled from social-media posts, donations and coworker reports, nor DOGE access to personnel databases for termination. blocking_reasons.entry-6444: No dated statement or filing in the review establishes Trump or his legal team claiming “absolute immunity” for any presidential action in April 2025. The exact quote, speaker and legal context are required before a narrower draft is possible.
blocking_reasons.entry-6501: The reviewed May 9, 2019, date-specific archive lists seven posts and none matches the alleged nuclear-policy “hearby” text. A direct original-platform capture or equivalent contemporaneous archive is needed to establish the exact tweet.
blocking_reasons.entry-6584: No dated DOJ clemency warrant or White House instrument in the reviewed evidence establishes a second pardon of Joe Arpaio on Jan. 20, 2025. The listed DOJ and White House URLs were leads only; their source text was not opened in this review.
blocking_reasons.entry-6611: The latest review found no sufficiently supported discrete event matching the claim that Bondi dropped or suspended Trump-allies cases on her first day. The only listed Reuters source is a packet lead about her Senate confirmation, not evidence of case dispositions. A dated DOJ order or case-by-case disposition is required.
blocking_reasons.entry-6662: No transcript or source in the review establishes the specific May 2025 “saved the economy” quote, and no attributable evidence supports “every major economist” disagreeing. Required evidence is the exact dated statement and named economic analyses with their projections.
blocking_reasons.entry-6739: The broad claim that all federal LGBTQ+-specific health programs ended on Jan. 20, 2025, is unsupported. Identify the specific program, the dated day-one action affecting it, and primary evidence showing that the program ended.
blocking_reasons.entry-6780: The review found no credible source that Trump or senior White House officials floated or endorsed a constitutional amendment eliminating judicial review. An attributable dated quote or formal proposal is required.
blocking_reasons.entry-6794: No matching credible source was located for rescission of Biden-era settlement agreements or court monitoring of immigration detention. A specific agreement, court order, facility and dated rescission are needed.
blocking_reasons.entry-6821: The cited HHS pages were not independently read and, according to the latest review, address one-time Title X supplements and funding opportunities rather than a termination of all Title X grants or all federal family-planning programs. HHS program and grant records showing a dated termination are required.
blocking_reasons.entry-6839: The supplied review notes GAO reports EAJA awards through FY2025 and explains that the statute continues to operate. It does not identify a dated administration action ending EAJA enforcement or funding. The GAO URL was not independently opened in this pass; an official action establishing the alleged change is required.
blocking_reasons.entry-6913: The reviewed material supports that Republican committees spent money at Trump properties but does not establish that rates were above market. A reliable comparable-price analysis is required; spending totals alone cannot support the headline claim.
